name: co-hoc-ly-thuyet-static-reader
description: Dev-only QA scripts for the offline mechanics textbook reader.

scripts.test:sim:physics: node tests/sim2-physics-port.test.js && node tests/sim2-transform.test.js && node tests/sim2-ch1-physics.test.js && node tests/sim2-ch2-physics.test.js && node tests/sim2-ch3-physics.test.js && node tests/sim2-route-coverage.test.js && node tests/sim2-no-legacy-physics.test.js && node tests/sim2-removal-guard.test.js
scripts.test:sim:mount: playwright test tests/sim2-ch1-mount.spec.js tests/sim2-ch1-integration.spec.js tests/sim2-ch2-mount.spec.js tests/sim2-ch3-mount.spec.js tests/sim2-mount-robustness.spec.js tests/content-only-smoke.spec.js
scripts.test:sim:release: npm run test:sim:physics && npm run test:sim:mount && npm run test:content && npm run test:quiz
scripts.test:equations: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Get-ChildItem scripts/test-phase-*.py | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Host \"=== $($_.Name) ===\"; & python $_.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 } }"
